description: The other half of the collision: a `Session` that is not `pipe.rpc`'s.

Here a session is a subscription — an identity and whether it is still delivering — and `Frame` is what it delivers. The shared name is the point of the fixture, and `Frame` is here so one file needs both kinds of import: a sibling inside its folder and a vocabulary shape outside it.
When each frame crossed, in the shared spelling.

types.name: Session
description: A subscription, which this contract also calls a session.

fields.name: active
description: Whether frames are still being delivered.

types.name: Frame
description: One delivered line. A local shape beside an imported one, so this file's imports go both ways: into its own folder and out of it.

fields.name: session
description: Whose stream this is. A sibling, so its import stays inside the folder.

fields.name: meta
description: When it crossed. Imported, so its import leaves the folder.

fields.name: line
description: The bytes that crossed, as text.
